verdicts.reason: A is a broken resize. The navy frame sits empty in the middle as a meaningless box. The headline has been pulled outside the frame into the upper-left at a tiny size, and the triangle and mug logo are stranded at the bottom-left. The brush-stroke background is only a thin strip with large areas of empty white above and below it. B at least keeps the headline, logo and triangle together inside the frame. But the triangle is blown up into the main focal point and the mug logo is oversized and nearly touches it. The headline is small and pushed into the bottom-left corner, so it is far too weak. The background is again a thin strip in a mostly white canvas.
